description:
Jettly helps you search and book private jet charters directly within ChatGPT. Compare available aircraft, review seating capacity and pricing, and find the best option for your trip.

Search one-way, round-trip, or multi-city private jet itineraries by providing your departure location, destination, travel dates, and passenger count. Jettly automatically resolves airport options and displays available aircraft in an interactive experience.

When you're ready to travel, select your preferred aircraft and continue to Jettly's secure booking flow to complete your reservation.

defaultPrompt: Charter a private jet from New York to Miami for 4 passengers.
